meta.name: docx
meta.description: Use this skill whenever the user wants to create, read, edit, or manipulate Word documents (.docx files) or Word templates (.dotx files). Triggers include: any mention of 'Word doc', 'word document', '.docx', '.dotx', or requests to produce professional documents with formatting like tables of contents, headings, page numbers, or letterheads. Also use when extracting or reorganizing content from .docx or .dotx files, inserting or replacing images in documents, performing find-and-replace in Word files, working with tracked changes or comments, or converting content into a polished Word document. If the user asks for a 'report', 'memo', 'letter', 'template', or similar deliverable as a Word or .docx file, use this skill. Do NOT use for PDFs, spreadsheets, Google Docs, or general coding tasks unrelated to document generation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要制作或修改格式复杂的Word文档。
copy.tagline_en: Create and edit formatted Word documents.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently produce or modify Word documents with complex formatting.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能创建、编辑、读取 Word 文档，提取或重组内容，插入/替换图片，查找替换文字，处理修订和批注，并将内容转换为排版好的 Word 文件。
howto.when: 当用户提到 “Word doc”、“.docx”、“.dotx” 等，或要求制作带目录、页码等格式的 Word 文档，或要求把报告、备忘录等输出为 Word 文件时触发。

say.text: 帮我新建一个 Word 文档，带目录和页码。
把这 .docx 里的图片换成另一张。
读取这个 Word 文件，把内容整理成要点。

howto.what_en: Creates, edits, reads Word documents (.docx/.dotx), extracts or reorganizes content, inserts/replaces images, find-and-replaces text, handles tracked changes and comments, and converts content into formatted Word files.
howto.when_en: Triggers on mentions of 'Word doc', '.docx', '.dotx', or requests for formatted Word documents (TOC, page numbers, etc.), or reports, memos, letters as Word files. Not for PDFs, spreadsheets, or Google Docs.

say_en.text: Create a new Word document with a table of contents and page numbers.
Replace the image in this .docx with another one.
say_en.note: Replaces the image in the original document.

say_en.text: Read this Word file and summarize the content into bullet points.
